gates.sentence: The period of 79.0 days is 2.5 resolution elements from the nearest calendar period (one year / 4); that is clear of it.
The observing pattern has 0% of its power at this period; the sampling does not explain the signal.
Removing any one of 5 years moves the phase by at most 0.02 cycles and the amplitude by a factor of 0.38 to 1.36; the most important year carries 89% of the evidence. The signal depends on one year.
The signal is visible in fewer than two bands: no comparison possible.
Searched alone, the first 70% of the time span prefers a period of 59.8 days, not 79.0: the early data do not find this signal independently.
The warped-time test was not run.

what_would_change_this: New data are the test. If the period is real, the periodic model fitted now will fit data taken later better than red noise alone; if it is a red-noise bump, it will not. No prediction was recorded for this object, because it was not promoted.
